name: PermitToWorkIssuer
tagline: Hot work, confined space, LOTO and height permits with precautions, gas tests, countersigned sign-off and validity – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete permit-to-work app for facilities and property teams: raise, authorise, countersign, issue, suspend, extend and close permits for high-risk work with mandatory precaution checklists per permit type, gas tests against limits, isolation points shared across permits, validity limits, SIMOPS conflict checks and a printable permit. Control room, lifecycle board, register, shift timeline and isolation register. Runs in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Sign-off chain: draft, requested, authorised, countersigned, issued, suspended, closed, cancelled with allowed moves only
Two-person rule: issuer is not the performer; countersignature for hot work, confined space, LOTO and every High-risk permit
Mandatory precaution checklists per permit type (low-code settings)
Gas tests (O2, LEL, H2S, CO) with limits and validity; a failed test suspends a live permit automatically
Isolation register with shared LOTO points that stay locked until every permit is closed
SIMOPS conflicts for incompatible work at the same location and time, with linked-permit exemption
Validity limits (12 h, hot work 8 h), extensions, closing-soon and overdue alerts, lapsed permits
Close and hand back with fire watch minutes for hot work
Drag-and-drop lifecycle board and shift timeline with now line
Printable permit text (PermitText output), bulk authorise, cancel, export; undo; dated history
Desktop, tablet and phone layouts with bottom bar
Power Fx outputs and events, Dataverse direct save, Power Pages Web API
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
